author: 130R
body:
We need to fix the Avicacde. Great potential, but...


* Kits not spawning in OITC? Really?

* Spawn Killing is way to easy in OITC

* The Death Race Minotaur map Sucks

* The Minotaur can kill everyone as soon as they spawn in Hell Bound

* Players can memorise the route in the maze

* In one game I didn't show on the scoreboard of OITC


Get it sorted, guys!

replies.author: QFrog
replies.body: All these bugs have been reported already, people should read the stickied post. https://github.com/Avicus/Issues/issues is where you put bugs.

replies.author: 130R
replies.body: My point is not to report bugs. I know about the issue tracker. My point is to emphasise how half-baked Avicade is, and how much work it needs to be seamless and enjoyable.

replies.author: San_David
replies.body:
Now, while I do agree with most of the things you points out, there's one thing you said that bugged me...

"The Death Race Minotaur map Sucks"

Then, please tell me, what is your problem with it? You're criticizing it for what seems to be the sheer fact that you don't like it. If you think it sucks, then at least give some pointers on WHY it sucks, because, as you have it now, you aren't helping anyone.
